# Project

*Documentation **v1.3** — MAJOR.MINOR (see README.md footer).*

**Messenger-Native SaaS** — Heartmade Studio reference repository. It showcases a modern blueprint for micro-SaaS products that replace traditional browser dashboards with native messenger UX (e.g. Telegram). The system is Edge-first and centers on an **Onboarding-first flow**.

## Core architecture stack

- **UX / front-end:** Telegram Bot API (replaces web and mobile apps).
- **Backend / compute:** Supabase Edge Functions (Deno) for low-latency event handling.
- **Database:** Supabase (PostgreSQL).
- **Subscriptions & payments:** Stripe (webhooks + hosted Checkout).
- **Intelligence (AI composition):** Gemini API (Google AI) for dynamic creation of **personalized cues**.
- **Observability:** PostHog (product analytics) and Sentry (error tracking on Edge).

## Main principles (philosophy)

- **Low friction, high retention:** No passwords; no separate mobile app install.
- **Onboarding-first flow:** User data and service setup happen through a guided conversation at launch (four steps), then a free trial starts (e.g. 14 days). Payments and checkout are handled by Stripe.

This file is LLM-oriented context for the repository’s current architecture. Use these technical constraints when generating or extending features.
